## Market.isHealthy() method

Returns whether a given borrow position is healthy. `undefined` iff the market's oracle is undefined or reverts.

**Signature:**

```typescript
isHealthy(position: {
        collateral: bigint;
        borrowShares: bigint;
    }): boolean | undefined;
```
